title: Resave session does not work after first exit
body:
## Issue description

While creating session for the first time, it's resave tabs and pane information, but after first exit, it does not resave new changes, so after resurrection it always will be as firstly saved version

## Minimal reproduction

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c3d355e-ed0a-4ba5-8861-a9d324ed2c70

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: I can confirm, that session-layout.kdl don't update after first exit, but session-metadata.kdl successfully update

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Anything in the logs? (For me they're located at `/tmp/zellij-1000/zellij-log/zellij.log`)

comments.author: reporter
reporter
comments.body:
> How did you install Zellij?

Download zellij-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz from latest release, then move it to `/home/<user>/.local/bin/zellij`, give execution permission

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: That was my guess. Could you try to see if you can reproduce this with a compiled version? (eg. with `cargo install --locked zellij`)

comments.body: I found [the same problem](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/issues/4536) some time ago, but in my case I installed and updated Zellij via Omakub. My logs look almost exactly the same as those that @reporter has shown. Later I will try to reproduce the issue with the compiled version to see if I find that can be useful to debug it.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Thanks both. I plan to take a closer look as part of a large list of fixes/investigations before the upcoming version release in the next few weeks.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
> Thanks both. I plan to take a closer look as part of a large list of fixes/investigations before the upcoming version release in the next few weeks.

I have two questions: do you have plans to implement manual saving? And the second one - is it possible to implement manual saving via plugin?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
I issued a fix for this in #4604. The specific problem happens when starting or resurrecting sessions from the welcome screen. Thanks for the report!

As for your questions @reporter - manually saving sessions will be possible in the next version through the session-manager. As so, it will also be available as an API.

Also, there will be a new `layout-manager` interface, allowing you to save a session directly into your layouts folder and thus more easily sharing it with others and recreating it (or partially recreating it, eg. just a specific tab): https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/pull/4601
